body: T11b — the inference chain, second slice of the T11 umbrella. Contract: .adlc/specs/T11b-claude.md (fork of T11b.md). Owns AC1 (real LLM handler: Moonshot kimi-k3, MOONSHOT_API_KEY, zero new deps, stdlib :httpc/:ssl, injectable HTTP client with a stub adapter for tests), AC3 (re-boot idempotence WITH the LLM handler — crash-window test asserts one request + one response + a counted skip), AC4 (operational run with a REAL Moonshot call — recorded at close-out by Hermes; the build's gate is the suite + deliverables), AC5 (store-as-memory: grounded follow-up 'what did I just say?' references the first exchange), AC8 (tool chains as cascades of linked deltas: ToolCall -> executor -> ToolResult -> Response, mid-chain restart resumes, projection is a lens), AC9 (T10 deterministic loop untouched), AC10 gates. Carried additions (binding): thread Kyber.Schema.validate/1 into admission (door/schema seam), boot-time rehydration of schema evolution, resolve answers plain maps. Deliverables: Kyber.Agent.LlmHandler, Kyber.Agent.ContextBuilder (session hyperview + window lens + memory injection via the MemoryPort seam), Kyber.Agent.Engine (stateful turn holder, pointer-walk rehydration), tool executor handler(s), Kyber.Agent.MemoryPort (retriever seam + stub), CLI 'kyber agent'. Gate: mix test && test -f lib/kyber/agent/llm_handler.ex && test -f lib/kyber/agent/context_builder.ex && test -f lib/kyber/agent/engine.ex && test -f lib/kyber/agent/memory_port.ex; T10 tests untouched; rails-guard clean; no Process.sleep.
title: T11b-claude: inference chain — claude-code / Fable 5 leg (blind taste-test vehicle A)
